verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping and enrichment API, so proxy-rotation retries on anti-bot blocks are a fair question for it. The evidence contains nothing about proxies, proxy chains, or anti-bot handling. The only retry evidence covers SDK client-side retries on 429s and transient GET failures against Riveter's own API, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically retry through a chain of different proxies when anti-bot detection blocks a request
